title: libcuflynx calibration workflow (calibration_workflow.json)
description: Ordered calibrations, and the analyses around them, whose calibrated values are merged into one model, the target. A step's kind is calibration (the default), sensitivity, reduction, emulation, identifiability, set, sweep or uq; every kind but reduction, set and sweep names the three inputs of an ordinary run: a model (a CA module array, a module of a module library, an external Python model or a CellML model), an obs_data file and a params_for_id file; paths are relative to this file. Run with cuflynx-calibration-workflow or libcuflynx.calibration_workflow.run_calibration_workflow. The checks that need the files and the module library (they exist, each step's model sits in the target) are in libcuflynx/calibration_workflow/resolve.py; the rest are in spec.py as well as here.

target.description: the model the calibrated values are merged into

module_library_dirs.description: module libraries, relative to this file; more can be given on the command line

oneOf.description: a CA module array; its parameters file is <prefix>_parameters.json beside it

items.description: an instance of the target: a record name, or a path into a super instance (heart/lv)

select.description: instances of the workflow's module-array target, calibrated as they are in it. One instance is calibrated as its library module, placed at that instance; several (records of the target) as the module array they form, cut from the target

selection.description: a selection of the target's instances

parameters.description: its parameters file; default <prefix>_parameters.json beside it

external_model_path.description: a .py file defining SIM_HELPER, run as model_type external_python; its parameters are the class's component/variable names

external_model.description: an external Python model. A step with one needs a target that is the same file; it is run with the step's values in an external_parameters_file and is never generated

cellml_model_path.description: a CellML file (its imports beside it, as it names them); its parameters are its constants, named component/variable

parameters.description: a parameters file ({component: {variable: {value, units}}}) whose values replace the CellML's

cellml_model.description: a CellML model, run as model_type cellml. A step with one needs a target that is the same file; it runs a flattened copy with the step's values written in

allOf.description: "instance" is not a target key: a target names its parameter set with "parameterisation".

module_type.description: the module type (a module config entry's module_type)

library_module.description: a module of a module library: one parameterisation of one version

settings.description: user_inputs settings for the steps (a step's are merged over the workflow's, one dict level deep). The model, obs_data, params_for_id and output directories are chosen by the workflow and cannot be set.

param_reduction_options.description: How a reduction step chooses the parameters to calibrate: the user_inputs param_reduction_options (ANALYSIS_OPTIONS['param_reduction'] in libcuflynx.parsers.PrimitiveParsers) without the paths, which the workflow chooses. {} is PCA with every default. With method manual the choice is made by hand: the parameters named, for the reason given. Only a reduction step has them; the workflow's own settings do not.

method.description: pca: one parameter per informative PCA mode of the Sobol outputs (scaled by obs_data std and weight). sobol: the n_params parameters with the highest Sobol index. manual: the parameters named in parameters, chosen by hand for the reason given; the step reads no sensitivity step and names the params_for_id whose entries it keeps.

n_params.description: how many parameters to keep (pca: at most, default one per informative mode; sobol: required)

criterion.description: sobol: a parameter's score, the max or mean of its index over the outputs

threshold.description: sobol: drop parameters scoring below this

min_mode_std.description: pca: a mode is informative when its std over the Sobol samples is at least this many obs_data stds. The samples fill the whole prior box (the sensitivity step's params_for_id bounds), so this is a global, prior-wide measure of what a parameter can do, not local to the fitted values

variance_fraction.description: pca: only the leading modes explaining this fraction of the scaled variance; 1 (default) is no relative cut

min_index.description: pca: with redundancy_check, a parameter whose largest index over the informative modes is below this is not a candidate; without it, skip a mode whose largest index among the free parameters is below this

redundancy_check.description: pca: keep a parameter only if its effect on the informative modes, beyond what the kept parameters explain, is at least min_mode_std noise stds (from the Sobol run's local Jacobian). Off: one parameter per informative mode.

redundancy_statistic.description: pca with redundancy_check: summarise a parameter's unexplained effect over the Jacobian points by its rms (any point counts) or median (most points must agree)

redundancy_converged_only.description: pca with redundancy_check: leave out Jacobian points whose derivatives at the step and half of it disagree; needs sa_options.jacobian_check_steps

redundancy_convergence_tol.description: redundancy_converged_only: largest change between the two steps, relative to the effect (or min_mode_std, if larger)

parameters.description: manual (required): the parameters to keep, each named as its params_for_id entry is labelled (heart/E_lv_A; a grouped entry's names joined by +; a modifier's name)

reason.description: manual (required): why these parameters were chosen

then.description: A manual reduction needs parameters (the names kept) and reason.

else.description: parameters and reason are for a manual reduction.

oneOf.description: a step id; its stored distribution, as the default kind (mvnormal)

step.description: the step whose stored distribution is used (a calibration with store_distribution, or a uq step)

kind.description: how the stored samples are represented: a multivariate normal, independent normals, or a kernel density estimate, each on a scale on which the parameter bounds are unbounded

inflate.description: multiplies the distribution's variance, to temper an overconfident earlier posterior

parameters.description: only these parameters (model names in the source step), not all of them

entry.description: a modifier's theta: the name of the params_for_id modifier entry it is the theta of, in the steps that take this step as start_from or result_from

theta.description: the theta of the modifier entry named by "entry": where a calibration starts it, or what an analysis is at. The parameters it modifies keep their values in the step's model. Only in a set step with "point": true

parameter.description: the parameter, <vessel>/<parameter> as the target names it (global/<parameter> for a global)

value.description: the value it is set to

of.description: what "scale" multiplies: a calibration or set step, whose value of this parameter is used, or "inherited", the value the target gives it

units.description: its units; by default those the target or the "of" step gives it

reason.description: why it has this value: shown beside it wherever the value is reported

set_entry.description: one value set by hand: a parameter's value, a scale of an existing value, or the theta of a params_for_id modifier entry

scale.description: log spaces the points by ratio

factors.description: these multiples of the value the step's model gives it

id.description: a label for the step, unique in the file: other steps refer to it, and it names the step's output directory; not "." or "..", nor a name the run's output directory uses itself: "models" (models generated for viewing), "target" (the target's view), "_target" (the generated target) or "inputs" (the study's copies of its inputs)

kind.description: calibration: a param_id run (MCMC with store_distribution). sensitivity: sensitivity analysis (settings.sa_options). reduction: chooses the parameters to calibrate from a Sobol sensitivity step (sensitivity_from, settings.param_reduction_options), for a calibration's or emulation's params_for_id_from. With method manual the choice is made by hand: the parameters named, of the step's own params_for_id, and no sensitivity_from. emulation: trains an emulator (settings.emulator_settings) for steps with emulator_from. identifiability: identifiability analysis (settings.ia_options) at the values of result_from, or at the model's own. uq: uncertainty quantification (settings.UQ_options, method mcmc or laplace) at the values of result_from, or at the model's own, with no fit of its own; it stores the distribution it finds, for priors_from. set: declares values or scales by hand (set), for fixed_from and the target. combine: gives one value per parameter from several calibration, set or combine steps (combine_from, combine), for fixed_from and the target in place of theirs. sweep: runs a model across chosen parameter values (sweep), feeding nothing forward. A step of any other kind than reduction, set, combine or sweep needs model, obs_data and params_for_id (a calibration or emulation may give params_for_id_from instead).

model.description: the model this step runs on

obs_data.description: the obs_data file it is run against

params_for_id.description: the params_for_id file: what it calibrates or analyses; for a reduction chosen by hand (method manual), the file whose entries it keeps

submodule.description: a library module in a library supermodule target: where it sits, a submodule name or a nested one as soma/i_M (soma_i_M is also read). Inferred when the module type and version occur once.

vessel.description: a library module in a module-array target: the vessel it is. Inferred when the module type and version occur once.

vessel_map.description: a module-array model: its vessel names -> the target's (a submodule path for a library target). Unmapped vessels keep their names.

oneOf.description: a step id: every value it calibrated or set, and the values it was given as fixed

step.description: the calibration, set or combine step whose values are fixed

parameters.description: only these of the values the step calibrated or set (model names in that step); its other values, and the values it was given as fixed, are not given

fixed_from.description: calibration, set or combine steps whose values are fixed in this step's model: a step id (every value it calibrated or set, and the values it was given as fixed), or {step, parameters} for only some of its own values; this step runs after them

priors_from.description: earlier steps whose stored distributions become priors here: a calibration with store_distribution, or a uq step; their parameters are calibrated again in this step, with that prior

store_distribution.description: after the fit, sample the posterior by MCMC (needs UQ_options) and store it (chain, samples, stats) for later steps and tools

on_target.description: (sweep) run on the target with every calibration's, set step's and combine step's values merged as the target merges them, a later step winning; such a step names no model, fixed_from or result_from, and runs after every such step

emulator_from.description: an emulation step whose emulator this step runs on (calibration, sensitivity, identifiability or uq), with that step's model; give the same model, obs_data and params_for_id as it

emulator_dir.description: an emulator trained outside the workflow (a directory holding emulator_metadata.json), relative to this file, that this step runs on (calibration, sensitivity, identifiability or uq); not with emulator_from. It must have been trained on this step's model, obs_data and params_for_id

result_from.description: a calibration, set or combine step whose values, including those of the parameters this step analyses, this step's model is generated with (sensitivity, identifiability, uq or sweep: the analysis is at those values; without it, at the model's own)

start_from.description: (calibration) a calibration, set or combine step whose values of this step's own parameters are where its fit starts: the step's model is generated with them, so they are the optimiser's initial point. They are not fixed, and do not reach the target

sensitivity_from.description: a reduction step: the Sobol sensitivity step whose results it reduces (none for a reduction chosen by hand, method manual)

params_for_id_from.description: a calibration or emulation step: the reduction step whose params_for_id it uses instead of its own; a step on that emulator names the same reduction

set.description: a set step: the values it declares

point.description: (set) the step's values are a point only, for start_from, result_from or fixed_from: they are not merged into the target and are not counted as calibrating it. An explicit key, so a workflow's meaning never depends on how its steps are used

combine_from.description: a combine step: the calibration, set or combine steps whose values it combines; it runs after them, and its values replace theirs in later steps and in the target

method.description: best_fit: every value of the calibration with the lowest cost; the steps are calibrations of the same obs_data, with the same cost_type and the same parameters. mean: each parameter's mean over the steps that give it

combine.description: a combine step: how it gives one value per parameter

design.description: grid: every combination. one_at_a_time: each parameter's values with the others at the model's values

outputs.description: variables recorded over time at each point

parameters.description: <vessel>/<parameter>, as a params_for_id names it, and the values it takes. Empty: one run of the protocol as the model has it

zip.description: groups of parameters that move together: the i-th point of the group takes each one's i-th value, so their value lists have one length; the design treats a group as one parameter

sweep.description: a sweep step: its points, and what each records. An obs_data gives the protocol, and its prediction items a feature per point; without one, settings give dt and sim_time

simulate.description: a simulate step: one run of its model through the protocol of its obs_data (whose prediction items give features), or of settings' pre_time and sim_time. It writes what a sweep of no parameters writes

function.description: a figure step: "<script>.py:<function>", the script's path relative to this file. The function's parameters are the names of "inputs" and out_dir; it writes its files into out_dir and returns their paths. The script also has a main (libcuflynx.calibration_workflow.figures.figure_main), so it runs on its own on a finished run

inputs.description: a figure step: each parameter of its function by its name (a Python name), and what it is given

files.description: a figure step: other files its script reads or imports (helpers, a style module), relative to this file. A change to one makes the figure out of date, and they are packed with the script

then.description: A reduction chosen by hand (method manual) needs params_for_id, the file whose entries it keeps, and has no sensitivity_from.
A reduction that reads a sensitivity step needs sensitivity_from and has no params_for_id.
A combine step needs combine_from (the steps it combines) and combine (its method).
combine_from and combine are for a combine step.
A simulate step names its model (or "on_target": true) and no params_for_id.
A figure step names its function and inputs.

else.description: A step that is not a reduction, set, combine, sweep, simulate or figure step names its model, obs_data and params_for_id (a calibration or emulation may take params_for_id from a reduction instead: params_for_id_from, not both).

reduction_step_settings.description: a reduction step's only setting is param_reduction_options: its own options, {} for PCA with every default

figure_input.description: {"<kind>": "<step id>"}: one kind of result of one step. sweep: a sweep or simulate step's arrays; values: what a calibration or set step gave; obs_data and params_for_id: a step's files; sensitivity: Sobol indices; distribution: a stored posterior; laplace: an identifiability step's approximation
